title: Battery Drain
description: Interactive p5.js simulation demonstrating how battery discharge rates are affected by motor speed, teaching concepts of power consumption and energy management in robotics.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Battery
Power Consumption
Electric Motor
Robotics
Energy Management
learningObjectives: Predict how increasing the motor speed slider changes the rate at which the battery charge indicator drops
Explain why the battery does not drain at all when the motor speed is set to zero
Trace the circuit path from the battery's positive terminal through the wires to the motor and back to the negative terminal
Explain why the motor stops spinning once the battery charge indicator reaches empty
Relate motor speed to power consumption to estimate how long the battery will last at different slider settings
